name: legacy-rescue-skill
description: Inherited a codebase nobody understands? Map it, pin its behaviour with tests, and change it in small reversible steps.

plugins.name: legacy-rescue-skill
plugins.description: Eight Claude Code skills and three agents for rescuing legacy code without breaking production: map the repo, find hotspots and dead code, write characterization tests, plan dependency upgrades and strangler migrations, refactor in a strict loop, and compile a 30/60/90-day plan.
